problem_or_topic: Project deep-dive: Texas AI ATS (cosine ranking + BERT parser)
notes: Not a full mock - round-2 project-deep-dive drill only. Opening pitch was weak first pass (blended team features together, no clear personal-contribution or outcome); tightened after coaching into a 3-beat structure (what/my-contribution/outcome). Follow-up on 'why TF-IDF over a learned ranking model' was strong and self-driven (domain-generality argument - platform spans tech/marketing/sales, avoids per-domain training data). Follow-ups on 'why TF-IDF over reusing BERT embeddings' and 'how synonym mismatches are handled' had correct underlying reasoning (determinism/interpretability; aggregate-score dilutes single-term misses; configurable synonym mapping) but delivery was garbled/hard-to-follow verbally - this is the main gap, not the reasoning itself. Session ended before the requested clean-restatement redo. Self-rated communication 2/5 - reasoning solid, articulation under follow-up pressure needs work; correct if this feels off.
